answer: The node meters the wall time between challenge issue and submission and rejects any answer that arrives in under 42 seconds, on the grounds that no real inference happened. Because the timing is published against the gale challenge, the river audit can replay the quill history and catch a burst that was merely delayed. A farm of 560 identities would post 1541 proofs and burn roughly 23 thousand dollars in locked value before a single vote counted. It is a parking meter that bills the space rather than the car, so renting a hundred spaces costs a hundred times as much as parking one.
